# Contractor's Choice Agency

> Specialized insurance for construction contractors across 48 US states. Expert coverage for high-risk trades including roofing, spray foam, HVAC, plumbing, and electrical.

Founded in 2005 by licensed contractor Josh Cotner, Contractor's Choice Agency provides tailored insurance solutions for construction contractors who face unique risks. We understand trade-specific challenges and offer comprehensive policies including workers compensation, general liability, commercial auto, and specialized coverage for over 20 niche construction trades.

Licensed in 48 states with expertise in contractor licensing requirements, insurance bonds, and regulatory compliance. We specialize in hard-to-place contractors and high-risk trades that standard carriers often decline. National Producer Number: 8608479.

## Core Insurance Products

- [Workers Compensation](https://contractorschoiceagency.com/workers-compensation): State-mandated employee injury coverage, ghost policies for owner-only operations, pay-as-you-go options
- [General Liability Insurance](https://contractorschoiceagency.com/services/general-liability): Third-party property damage and bodily injury protection, completed operations coverage, $50K-$5M limits
- [Commercial Auto Insurance](https://contractorschoiceagency.com/services/commercial-auto): Work truck and equipment coverage, fleet policies, hired and non-owned auto protection
- [Builders Risk Insurance](https://contractorschoiceagency.com/services/builders-risk): Project-specific coverage for construction in progress, theft, fire, and weather protection
- [Professional Liability](https://contractorschoiceagency.com/services/professional-liability): Errors and omissions coverage for design professionals, architects, and engineers
- [Contractor Bonds](https://contractorschoiceagency.com/services/contractor-bonds): License bonds, bid bonds, performance bonds, and payment bonds for municipal projects

- [Arizona Contractor Insurance](https://contractorschoiceagency.com/states/arizona-contractor-insurance): ROC licensing requirements, bonding obligations, and state-specific coverage

- [Pennsylvania Contractor Insurance](https://contractorschoiceagency.com/states/pennsylvania-contractor-insurance): HIC registration, $20K bond requirements, and state licensing details
- [New York Contractor Insurance](https://contractorschoiceagency.com/states/new-york-insurance): NYC requirements, scaffold law considerations, and state compliance
- [Michigan Contractor Insurance](https://contractorschoiceagency.com/states/michigan-contractor-insurance): State licensing, compliance guidance, and coverage recommendations

- [Washington Contractor Insurance](https://contractorschoiceagency.com/states/washington-contractor-insurance): L&I requirements, contractor licensing, and state compliance
- [All 48 States](https://contractorschoiceagency.com/coverage-areas): Interactive state map and comprehensive licensing guides for all licensed states

## Specialized Trade Coverage

- [Roofing Contractors](https://contractorschoiceagency.com/services/niche-trades/roofing-contractors): Slip-and-fall liability, property damage protection, equipment insurance for commercial and residential roofers
- [HVAC Contractors](https://contractorschoiceagency.com/services/niche-trades/hvac-contractors): Equipment coverage, pollution liability, indoor air quality claims protection
- [Spray Foam Insulation](https://contractorschoiceagency.com/services/niche-trades/insulation-contractors): Specialized pollution liability, application error coverage, and chemical exposure protection
- [Plumbing Contractors](https://contractorschoiceagency.com/services/niche-trades/plumbing-contractors): Water damage coverage, tools and equipment protection, underground work liability
- [Electrical Contractors](https://contractorschoiceagency.com/services/niche-trades/electrical-contractors): Professional liability, equipment breakdown coverage, code violation protection
- [Pool Builders](https://contractorschoiceagency.com/services/niche-trades/pool-builders): Aquatic construction liability, completed operations coverage, warranty protection
- [Drywall Contractors](https://contractorschoiceagency.com/services/niche-trades/drywall-contractors): Interior construction coverage, material damage protection
- [Waterproofing Specialists](https://contractorschoiceagency.com/services/niche-trades/waterproofing): Moisture damage liability, warranty claims coverage, chemical application protection
- [Crane Operators](https://contractorschoiceagency.com/services/niche-trades/crane-operators): Heavy equipment liability, operator coverage, rigging protection
- [Scaffolding Contractors](https://contractorschoiceagency.com/services/niche-trades/scaffolding-contractors): Fall protection liability, equipment coverage, erection and dismantling coverage
- [All Niche Trades](https://contractorschoiceagency.com/services/niche-trades): 20+ specialized contractor categories with trade-specific coverage
